pages.title: Never Really Aimed
pages.text: Faith was never sent to one place on purpose - it drifts toward whoever's paying attention, and mostly that's been the Hunger by default, since a sleeping god barely stirs enough to notice you at all.

pages.title: A Real Choice
pages.text: Step into the Warped Hollow and you'll be asked to actually direct it. Pledge to one god and their own dedicated Faith Altar opens up to you, along with a real perk built around what they care about. Stay neutral instead and you'll get a much fainter taste of every god's gift at once - noticeable, never their equal.

pages.title: Changing Your Mind
pages.text: A Pack of the Gods (paper, a feather, and Arcane Ink) lets you pledge elsewhere later. Nothing about your prior god is lost when you do - their altar simply stops listening to you until you come back.
